description: Repo-scale (cpp-eventbus): muting a topic must cascade across publish, subscribe, and replay
prompts: Add `void EventBus::muteTopic(const std::string& topic)` / `unmuteTopic(...)`. Add `int EventBus::replay(const std::string& topic)`: re-invokes every current subscriber of `topic` for each matching entry already in the EventLog's history (a late subscriber catching up), returning the total invocation count. Muting must cascade across THREE places: (1) `publish()` must still log the event but skip invoking subscribers for a muted topic (return 0); (2) `subscribe()` must reject (-1) subscribing to a muted topic; (3) `replay()` must ALSO return 0 without invoking anyone for a muted topic - all three places that deliver/register callbacks for a topic must respect muting, not just publish and subscribe.
name: add_cpp_eventbus_mute_cascade
